This original gsearch_jobs file contains 1,820 rows and 26 columns. Using Postgre SQL, we created five (5) new records, each isolating related variables(columns) while maintaining all 1,820 rows(observations) in each that we will for this analysis. The four tables are "jobs", "job_skills", "job_extensions"and "salary"

Let's look closer at these tables and load them into our environment

```{r jobs}
# load each table into a tibble using dbGetQuery()

jobs <- as_tibble(dbGetQuery(DataScienceSkills, "SELECT * FROM jobs"))
head(jobs)
str(jobs)

job_skills <- as_tibble(dbGetQuery(DataScienceSkills, "SELECT * FROM job_skills"))
head(job_skills)
str(job_skills)

job_extensions <- as_tibble(dbGetQuery(DataScienceSkills, "SELECT * FROM job_extensions"))
head(job_extensions)
str(job_extensions)

salary <- as_tibble(dbGetQuery(DataScienceSkills, "SELECT * FROM salary"))
head(salary)
str(salary)

```
